svg.aria-label: Landscape site plan at 1:100 with building and landscape axes and three levels of dimensions: the store's main axis continued as a 1.80 m walk into the garden, an entry plaza on a 60 cm grid, beds of maize, beans and squash and of medicinal herbs in front, dry and dye gardens along the sides, a rain garden behind the store fed by the green roof, a cistern and four native trees
svg.title: L-101 Landscape site plan
svg.text: terracotta 30 x 30 cm, basalt 60 cm grid
Drawn by Raymundo "R@y" Olguin | GreenStore, Puebla
